section_symbols.X: Pending — skeleton placeholder; InDialogue X-mode (build from scratch)
section_symbols.I: Initialized — seeded from decision-doc or retained on Reopen; InDialogue I-mode (display & confirm)
section_symbols.N/A-s: Not Applicable (structural) — excluded by change type
section_symbols.N/A-c: Not Applicable (content) — condition not triggered per decision-doc
section_symbols.D: In Dialogue — section currently being processed (only one D at a time)
section_symbols.V: Confirmed — user explicitly confirmed; content locked
section_symbols.!: Expired — upstream Reopen invalidated; requires re-review
section_symbols.S: Skipped — user explicitly confirmed exclusion (N/A-s / N/A-c → S)
